title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This is not a manuscript page. It is a typed page (p. 60 of Exposé IX, archive stamp 378) of Grothendieck's SGA 7 I, Exposé IX, 'Modèles de Néron et monodromie' (LNM 288). In the printed volume this text sits on p. 378. It is filed among the handwritten notes on the divided-power de Rham complex; the neighbouring pages are about endomorphisms of a simplicial divided-power differential algebra and have no connection to it.

Content, in modern terms. The setting is a discrete valuation ring S with residue field k, and an abelian variety A over the fraction field with dual A'. Their Néron models are related by the Weil (Poincaré) biextension.

1. The first lines finish the statement of Theorem 5.4. In the semistable case, the biextension induces a pairing between the abelian parts B_0 and B'_0 of the identity components of the special fibres. The theorem says this pairing is a perfect duality: B_0 is isomorphic to the dual of B'_0, and conversely.

2. The general proof is deferred to §7, where it follows from Raynaud's construction. This is the formal/rigid uniformization: a semi-abelian 'Raynaud extension' of an abelian scheme by a torus, quotiented by a lattice. Grothendieck notes that by 3.3 one may assume S complete.

3. §5.5 begins naming the outer graded pieces of the filtrations (5.1.10) and (5.1.11), i.e. the torus parts. It sets M'_0 = D(T_0) and M_0 = D(T'_0), the Cartier duals (character groups, twisted constant étale groups) of the maximal tori T_0 and T'_0 of the special fibres (SGA 3 X 5.7).

4. Because S is complete local, these étale groups lift uniquely to twisted constant group schemes M' and M over S. If T_0 is split, M' is the constant group on Hom_k-gr(T_0, G_m) = M'.

5. Since T_0 and T'_0 are isogenous (2.2.6), one is split exactly when the other is. These character groups are what later carry the monodromy pairing (Grothendieck's pairing M × M' → Z).

ideas.what: Duality between the abelian parts of the special fibres of the Néron models of A and A' in semistable reduction, induced by the Weil biextension
ideas.modern_name: Duality of abelian parts / Raynaud extension compatibility with duality
ideas.where_published: SGA 7 I, Exp. IX, Thm 5.4 and §7

ideas.what: Character groups of the maximal tori of the special fibres, viewed as twisted constant group schemes over a complete S
ideas.modern_name: Character groups X(T), X(T') entering the monodromy pairing

deep.surprise_reason: The page is the typescript of published SGA 7 IX, p. 378, misfiled among the notes on the divided-power de Rham complex. Everything on it is in print and credited.
transcription_corrections: The page is typed SGA 7 Exp. IX typescript (p. 60 = LNM 288 p. 378), not a handwritten note; it is unrelated to the surrounding pages on the divided-power de Rham complex.
The handwritten '194' at the bottom left is the archive page number; '378' appears twice, as a handwritten pencil number and as a typed stamp.
